status: QA guardrail for Lesson 1-14 enrichment; not a public content surface yet
purpose: Keep teacher-source facts separate from learner-aid enrichment, especially Hanja, Chinese glosses, and word-origin notes.

tiers.label: Teacher Source
tiers.definition: A fact, form, classroom contrast, example family, or pragmatic point grounded in the teacher PPTs or another named course source through sourceRefs.

tiers.label: Verified Enrichment
tiers.definition: A learner aid that goes beyond the teacher source and has been checked against an explicit dictionary, instructor review, or other named reference.

tiers.label: Unverified Enrichment
tiers.definition: Assistant-added learner support that is useful for review but has not yet been independently verified and should be hidden or visibly labeled before public display.

notes: Lesson 1-14 packs now declare Hanja, Chinese glosses, originType, and originNote as enrichment instead of teacher-source facts.
